name: 115dkk-lsp
description: Language server plugins for Claude Code that the official marketplace does not have: a web JavaScript stack plugin (Svelte server and an ESLint hook for React and Vite rules), a Python plugin built on Ruff's own server, a Qt stack plugin (qmlls, qmllint/uic/rcc checks, a compile database for qmake projects), a Slint plugin and a whitespace guard that preserves git's checkout line endings and reports indentation mismatches.

plugins.name: web-js-stack-lsp
plugins.description: Web JavaScript stack language server for Claude Code. A Svelte language server for .svelte files, and a PostToolUse hook that runs the project's own ESLint on each JS, TS or Svelte file Claude edits, so React (react-hooks), Vite (react-refresh) and Svelte (eslint-plugin-svelte) rules reach Claude right after the edit. TypeScript, JavaScript, JSX and TSX stay with the official typescript-lsp plugin.

plugins.name: ruff-server-lsp
plugins.description: Python language server for Claude Code built on `ruff server`, Ruff's own language server, instead of Pyright. Claude gets Ruff's lint diagnostics for .py and .pyi files right after each edit, using the project's pyproject.toml or ruff.toml. It does not type-check and offers no go-to-definition or references.

plugins.name: qt-stack-lsp
plugins.description: Qt stack support for Claude Code. A QML language server (Qt's own qmlls, found in the project's Qt installation even when it is not on PATH), a PostToolUse hook that checks edited .qml files with qmllint, .ui files with uic and .qrc files with rcc, and a skill that builds compile_commands.json from qmake-generated Makefiles so clangd can resolve Qt and project headers. C++ itself stays with the official clangd-lsp plugin.

plugins.name: slint-lsp
plugins.description: Slint language server for Claude Code. Starts slint-lsp, Slint's own language server, for .slint files, so Claude gets Slint's diagnostics right after each edit. Markup inside slint! macros in Rust files stays with rust-analyzer.

plugins.name: whitespace-guard
plugins.description: Before each Write, changes the line endings of the content to what git would check out, or to the existing file's endings when git has no rule, so a CRLF file stays CRLF. After each Write or Edit, reports lines just written whose indentation does not match the file's tabs-or-spaces style. It never writes files itself.
